title: RunnerProgress
description: POST /api/runners/jobs/{jobId}/progress: the lease heartbeat. Send at least once per lease (the Python runner sends every 30 s). Every field is optional.

stage.description: 'download' and 'upload' have fixed meanings (an 'upload' extends the job deadline); anything else reads as the kind's working stage (e.g. 'train', 'textures').

detail.description: Shown after the stage, clipped to 80 characters; a detail starting with 'step ' is dropped (the server prints the step itself).
